name: LOQOL seller portal
title: LOQOL Seller Portal Contribution | Leon Builds
desc: Leon contributed to LOQOL's seller portal, connecting disclosure answers to property records and adding safeguards for unfinished work.
lede: Real-estate disclosures take time to complete. Leon built parts of LOQOL's existing seller portal that connect answers to the right records and protect the text a seller is still writing.
image_alt: Implementation diagram, not a production screenshot: seller answer, local draft, and backend API
role: Frontend developer contributing to an existing product and design
decision_heading: Let the seller finish typing before replacing their answer.
problem: A seller is halfway through an answer when the page fetches an older saved copy. If the form replaces the text too soon, their unfinished work can disappear. Leon's work focused on that moment: keeping the answer being typed separate from the last saved version, and connecting each field to the right record.
built: Keep answers with the right record
Connected disclosure forms to the system that loads and updates each seller's answers.
Added automatic save requests when typing pauses, the seller moves to another field, or they close an unfinished form.
Kept the seller's current text separate from older saved answers arriving in the background.
evidence: Leon's work covers the form interface, its API connections and handling unfinished answers. The team already had the product and its design.
The diagram explains that work without showing seller records or private client documents. It is not a production screenshot.
The older public disclosure demo is linked separately, so it is not mistaken for this seller portal.
boundary: This is an implementation contribution, not ownership of the whole LOQOL platform or its original design. It is not a live test: a save request or a 'Saved' label alone does not prove the server kept the answer. Production rollout and completion-rate improvements have not been established by this case.
proof_links: See the separately labelled disclosure demo
